title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm
description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.

title: Shelpuk-AI-Technology-Consulting/kitty-bridge
description: Universal LLM bridge for AI agents. Use Claude Code with MiniMax, Codex with GLM, or Gemini CLI with OpenRouter — one command, any provider. Works with coding agents, OpenClaw, Hermes, and others.

title: cvsz/zworkforce
description: Enterprise AI Workforce Operating System — distributed control plane, durable agents, workflow automation, governance, MCP integration and AI FinOps.  zWorkforce turns one or more LLM endpoints into a governed AI workforce. A tenant dispatches work to named agents; a cost-aware Luna/Terra/Sol

title: 99percentgrip/agent-vesper
description: Agent Vesper is a pure-Rust AI agent harness that remembers you across conversations. It provides a provider-neutral runtime where any LLM provider can plug in — today it ships with the Z.ai GLM adapter, tomorrow any provider can join with zero TUI or runtime changes.

title: rorystandley/goose
description: Personal autonomous AI agent powered by a local Ollama LLM — no cloud, no subscriptions. Runs missions via Slack, CLI, or scheduler with tool use and approval gating.

title: CatCatUncle/openworkbuddy
description: Local-first AI office agent that hands you files, not chat logs: swap any LLM (or use local Claude Code/Codex), keep data on your machine, add a skill with one Markdown file. 本机 AI 办公 agent：吐文件不吐聊天记录，不绑模型，数据自己留着。

title: JetBrains/junie
description: An AI coding agent by JetBrains that ships code from your terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipeline - powered by any LLM you choose

title: icetomoyo/KodaX
description: A lightweight AI coding agent that actually works. KodaX is modular, zero-config, and supports multiple LLM providers out of the box. Use it as a CLI tool or npm library—with session memory, parallel execution, and agent teams. Written in TypeScript.

title: aunysillyme/model-orchestrator
description: Model orchestrator for AI coding agents and LLMs: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Grok, Qwen, Ollama. Routing rules tell your agent which model, subagent or CLI to use for each task, so small work goes to cheap tiers and fewer tokens go to frontier models. One installer, plus a CLI runner that logs every route.

title: PatrykPanasiuk/patcode
description: An open-source AI coding agent for the terminal. Connect to OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, or local LLMs to write, debug, and refactor code — directly from your CLI.

title: Akash010203/sovereign-ai-workbench
description: Sovereign AI Workbench is a locally controlled AI system that demonstrates how a small language model can be trained from scratch and integrated with retrieval, structured databases, tools, agents, and security controls without relying on an external LLM API or Ollama for model inference

title: choreographr/choreographr
description: Choreographr is an all purpose extensible AI agent system written entirely in Rust. It has a client/server architecture and can run many sessions simulataneously. It can be run locally or in the cloud. LLM generated code can be run in a sandboxed RISC-V VM for complete security and observability.

title: Osmantic/ODS
description: Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into an AI server.  LLM inference, chat UI, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, and image generation.

title: Dezz05/AuraSDK
description: Enable fast, local memory recall for AI agents using a lightweight, Rust-based cognitive memory engine with no cloud or LLM calls needed.

title: Md-Zubair677/Amazon-Support-Agent
description: AmazonHelp Customer Support Agent is an AI-powered support system that classifies customer queries, applies escalation policies, and determines whether requests should be auto-handled or sent to human support. It also includes LLM response evaluation, human judging, and AWS Bedrock integration for reliable AI support workflows.

title: jdorner/palim
description: Self-hosted AI agent platform with extensions, workflows, and a web UI. Local LLM inference via llama.cpp (or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint).

title: CowDogMoo/squad
description: Squad runs unattended AI agents, defined as markdown plus YAML, against any LLM provider in bounded, cost-capped tool loops - locally or on Docker, Kubernetes, or EC2.

title: goruck/home-generative-agent
description: AI agent for Home Assistant — talk to your home, create automations in plain language, analyze cameras with face recognition, and get proactive anomaly alerts. Cloud LLMs or fully local via Ollama.

title: agentd-dev/source-code
description: A minimal, MCP-native, cloud-native AI agent runtime. One small static Rust binary runs one agent: hand it an instruction and one LLM endpoint, and it runs the agentic loop — think, call a tool, observe, repeat — until the task reaches a terminal status or a new event wakes it.

title: cyb3rDem0n/astro-hunter
description: Astro Hunter is a scientific AI project composed of analysis pipelines, ML models, and LLM agents connected to open astronomical databases.  It downloads and analyzes real data, searches for anomalies or interesting signals, and uses agents to verify them, cross-reference them with catalogs, and formulate hypotheses.
